type.text: 剪一条片子：写字幕、烧进画面、做中文标题封面、两段拼一起

eval: (async()=>{const t=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t<90000){if(/四样都好了/.test(document.querySelector('.view.on').textContent))break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600))}const v=document.querySelector('.view.on');return {done:/四样都好了/.test(v.textContent),badCards:v.querySelectorAll('.card .tick.bad').length,cards:v.querySelectorAll('.card').length}})()

(async()=>{const vs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.view.on .pvmed video')];const one=el=>new Promise(r=>{const to=setTimeout(()=>r({t:'超时'}),12000);const go=()=>{clearTimeout(to);r({w:el.videoWidth,h:el.videoHeight,d:+(el.duration||0).toFixed(1)})};el.readyState>=1?go():el.onloadedmetadata=go});const out=[];for(const el of vs)out.push(await one(el));return {meta:JSON.stringify(out),durations:out.map(x=>x.d).join('+'),bothAbout8:out.filter(x=>x.d>6.5).length}})()
